europe_now.title: Drone incident in Germany has ‘hallmarks of state-sponsored terrorism’, EU's Kallas says
europe_now.summary: An EU official described a recent drone incident in Germany as showing hallmarks of state-sponsored terrorism. This assessment underscores serious security implications for the region.

europe_now.title: Von der Leyen, Rutte say Russian ‘intimidation will not work’ to stop Ukraine aid
europe_now.summary: EU leaders have declared that Russian intimidation tactics will not succeed in preventing aid to Ukraine. They maintain that continued support remains essential regardless of geopolitical pressure.
